$comment: ESP-2801 electric submersible pump twin. Expected values in Maximo Monitor from the pump stage curve, the affinity laws and the well design; the device sends only what it measures.

identification.model: Centrilift 400FLEXPump17.5 stages (pump); generic 375-series motor, seal and gauge
identification.description: Electric submersible pump in a vertical oil well, variable speed drive, downhole gauge
identification.pump: Centrilift 400FLEXPump17.5, mixed-flow stages, series 400 (4.00 in OD)
identification.motor: 3-phase induction motor, 375 series (3.75 in OD), oil filled (generic, assumption)
identification.seal: Seal chamber section (protector) between pump and motor
identification.gauge: Downhole gauge under the motor: intake and discharge pressure, temperatures, vibration, current leakage
identification.drive: Variable speed drive (VSD) at the wellsite, frequency set point from the production engineer

pump.source: Baker Hughes Centrilift 400FLEXPump17.5 pump data sheet (2023), https://dam.bakerhughes.com/m/3998f10b727fc547/original/Centrilift-400FLEXPump17_5-pump-slsh.pdf. Flow range, head, power and efficiency at BEP: from the data sheet. BEP flow 1,750 bbl/d, shut-off head 29 ft and zero-head flow about 3,100 bbl/d: read from the published curve (1,750 x 18.6 / 135,770 / 0.34 = 0.70, consistent with the 71 % stated). head_coef: H = a + b Q + c Q^2 per stage at 60 Hz (ft, bbl/d), fitted through those three points; power_coef: bhp per stage = p0 + p1 Q, fitted to the published power curve (within a few %). Stage count: assumption from the design of this well, replace with your ESP design report.

motor.source: assumption: typical value, replace with the motor nameplate and the vendor's motor temperature-rise data. Rated power scales with frequency (constant V/Hz); rise above intake temperature = rise_ref x (load / load_ref) x (v_ref / v)^0.5, a simple stand-in for the vendor's heat-transfer model. Alarm on the winding temperature well below the insulation rating.

well.source: assumption: typical value, replace with the well file (5 1/2 in 17 lb/ft casing, 3 1/2 in tubing, depths), the last build-up test (reservoir pressure, productivity index) and the flowline back-pressure.

fluid.source: assumption: typical value, replace with the PVT report (bubble point, solution gas-oil ratio, linear Rs below Pb) and the gas separator / gas handler rating of your string. 15 % free gas at the intake is used as the limit for these mixed-flow stages; ask the vendor for the rating of your stages.

operation.source: assumption: typical value, replace with the production engineer's frequency set point and the VSD run log.

demo.note: Demo only: the plant clock runs 60 times faster; counters (run days, starts) follow it.

groups.VSD: Variable speed drive at the wellsite

points.label: Motor current fluctuation over the last minute (std / mean)
Producing gas-oil ratio, last well test
Days since the ESP was installed

limits.source: assumption: typical value, replace with your own operating practice. Head ratio 0.92 / 0.80, power ratio 1.15, current fluctuation 5 %, 1,000 ft of fluid over the pump, 1.0 g, leakage 3 x the commissioning value (corrected to 220 °F, halving per 18 °F / 10 °C) or 20 µA.

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

stage_wear.name: Stage wear (sand, abrasion, radial bearings)
stage_wear.symptoms: head down at the same flow, efficiency down, power about the same, vibration up

scale_deposits.name: Scale in the stages
scale_deposits.symptoms: head down at the same flow, power up (friction in narrowed passages)

gas_interference.name: Gas interference, then gas lock
gas_interference.symptoms: free gas at the intake up, current erratic, flow down, then underload cycling

inflow_decline.name: Inflow decline (pump-off)
inflow_decline.symptoms: intake pressure and fluid level fall, flow below the recommended range

motor_cooling.name: Motor cooling loss (deposits on the housing, emulsion)
motor_cooling.symptoms: motor temperature rise higher than expected for the load and the fluid velocity

motor_insulation.name: Motor or cable insulation breakdown
motor_insulation.symptoms: current leakage rising faster than temperature explains

broken_shaft.name: Broken shaft or coupling
broken_shaft.symptoms: no head, motor near no-load, current steady
